start_game.Text: Hey there! Sorry to hear about your solitary confinement.
At least they left this Scarps board here for us to play.
Mind if I show you the ropes? I heard if you get good enough at it, you can even reduce your sentence!
The main goal is to match die faces in a column.
Points are tallied for each column by adding the face values.
If there are matching faces, those two die get a multiplier bonus!
For example, if you had two 5's in your column, your points would be (5 + 5) * 2
You can also match die on your opponents board, which removes all matching faces in a column.
As you beat opponents, I'll be inviting tougher folk to spread the word of your skills.
Once you're good enough, you might even be pardoned! Depending on what you did...
Enough talk, let's give it a shot!

start_game.Text: BEHOLD, CHILD!
You stand before Xygas, the Forever Fish, the Scaled One Who Persists!
I have been expecting you for some time now.
Once again, the threads of destiny have coiled around me.
My resting in this prison is no accident.
You believe this to be a game of chance, do you not?
FOOL! Chance is merely destiny wearing a cheap disguise!
Every card, every coin, every foolish wager brings us closer to the inevitable conclusion.
Your defeat.
My freedom.
My hypothesis is that you will try to gamble my fishbowl out from under my fins.
You falter at step one.
I have lived through eons that your species hasn’t existed for.
I traveled between realms, unimpeded for millennia.
I have watched civilizations rise from dust, build mighty towers, and crumble into the cold embrace of oblivion.
And now I reside in a vent.
Do not mistake my prison for weakness, child.
Come, then! Summon your courage!
You will not beat me.
You will not make me yield.
You will not win.
